svg.aria-label: SPECIMEN JAR — replays real agent MCP calls against a changed server. An iron shelf of glowing specimen jars; after the server swap, the broken ones rattle, flood red, and print ABNORMAL.
svg.title: SPECIMEN JAR — replays real agent MCP calls against a changed server. An iron shelf of glowing specimen jars; after the server swap, the broken ones rattle, flood red, and print ABNORMAL.

g.text: Jar your agent's real MCP calls.
Swap the server. Broken ones rattle.
